cases.title: The ageing card is titled by days OVERDUE, and its axis says so too
cases.steps: Sign in at http://localhost:8084 as the Sales POC holding the boundary invoices; read the dashboard
cases.expected: card title "Outstanding by days overdue" with the axis/subtitle "Days overdue"
cases.actual: title="Outstanding by days overdue", subtitle="Days overdue"

cases.title: Bucket labels are the five days-past-due bands, with no "days since invoice" wording left on the dashboard
cases.steps: Read every labelled node on the dashboard (scrolled top to bottom)
cases.expected: Not yet due / 1–30 days / 31–60 days / 61–90 days / Over 90 days present; no "days since invoice" and no "0–30 days" label anywhere
cases.actual: on screen: Not yet due, 1–30 days, 31–60 days, 61–90 days, Over 90 days; nothing matching the old wording among 68 distinct labels

cases.title: Coverage BOOK is shown on the card, so a POC knows the chart is their book and not the company
cases.steps: Same dashboard, signed in as a Sales POC (coverage BOOK from the API)
cases.expected: a "Your book" badge on the ageing card

cases.title: Clicking the "31–60 days" bar opens the invoice list filtered to that bucket
cases.steps: Click the 31–60 days bar on the ageing card; read the resulting URL and list
cases.expected: navigation to /invoices carrying a dueDate range filter plus the open-status filter, showing the 2 invoices behind the bar

cases.title: Loading the dashboard and following a bucket link raises no API error and no page exception
cases.steps: Collect every response >= 400 and every page error for the session above
cases.expected: no 4xx/5xx from the API, no uncaught JS error
